Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units from activities for assay CHEMBL3988443. Join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Filter to exact measurements where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
